title: Moral outlook and cooperation
text: Participants gain a better sense of their own moral outlook and develop practical skills for cooperation across differences in a diverse society.

title: Experience a deliberative process
text: Experience a deliberation process with conflicting interests and distributed knowledge, in the context of a formal and structured process enacting collective/public decisions.

title: Practice civil discourse skills
text: Practice civil discourse skills, namely engaging in productive conversations across differences in the context of matters of mutual concern when the stakes are sufficiently high.

title: Face trade-offs between moral values and strategic goals
text: Face trade-offs between moral values and strategic goals, and take a stand by making decisions in the exercise, which is real enough to reveal positions but still low-stakes enough to treat those as a learning experience.
